THE WORKSHEET GENERATOR

Make your own worksheet in one minute.

Pick words or sums, shuffle until it feels right, then print it or save it as a picture. Built right here in your browser — nothing is uploaded, and it even works offline once the page has loaded.

Pick a shelf of words from our classes, or type your own. Every shuffle makes a brand-new puzzle.

FOR GROWN-UPS

How the generator works.

Every sheet is made on your device — the words and sums never leave it. Shuffle deals a fresh layout from the same words, so siblings can each get their own puzzle. Print opens just the sheet on A4 or US Letter (the answer page follows when the box is ticked), and the picture buttons save PNG files you can drop into a slide, a message or a folder for later.

The word shelves follow our classes: the habitat animals from Class 36, the helpers from Class 33, the weather words from Class 34. Printed worksheets never mark anything complete in My Classroom — paper is for tables, kitchens and fridge doors.

COMING NEXT

More machines are on the drawing board.

Tracing sheets with the letters your child is practising, matching pairs drawn from our own artwork, and a name-writing sheet for the proudest signature in the house. The word search and the sums machine come first — tell us which one should follow.
